{"query":{"esql":"FROM filebeat-*
| WHERE fields.fuente == "waf-audit"
| EVAL minuto = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)
| STATS peticiones = COUNT(*) BY minuto, modsec.transaction.client_ip
| WHERE peticiones > 20
| SORT peticiones DESC
